text.en:
In addition to the present composition of every Regional Development Council, the President of
the Pampook na Katipunan ng mga Barangay, as certified to by the Secretary of Local Government and
Community Development or his representative, is hereby included therein as additional member thereof.

As member of the Regional Development Council, he shall be entitled to the same powers,
functions and/or privileges as are enjoyed and/or exercised by the members.

Any provision of law, decree or other issuances as well as executive orders and regulations
inconsistent herewith, are hereby repealed and/or modified accordingly.

This Decree shall take effect upon approval.
Done in the City of Manila, this 25th day of January, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-eight.
